descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you curious about how large global organizations manage technology risk at scale? Do you enjoy analysing complex problems and turning data into actionable insight? Are you eager to start your career in a team that safeguards the bank’s stability through modern risk management practices? If this sounds interesting take your next career step with UBS! As a part of your team, you will:
• Analyze technology risk data, reports and metrics to identify patterns, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk dashboards, reporting, and governance materials.
• Support automation, tooling enhancements, and AI adoption initiatives impacting technology risk.
• Work with stakeholders to incorporate risk and control requirements into application development backlogs.
• Assist in assessing control effectiveness and evaluating adherence to UBS policies and guidelines. Tech Graduate Program You will be participating in our immersive global graduate program. Not only will you connect with peers worldwide, it will offer you: Hands-on Experience: Gain exposure to a variety of tech projects from day one. Cutting-Edge Technologies: Stay updated with the latest tech. Professional Development: Enhance your technical skills through training and understand our business. Guidance from experts: Receive insights, advice, and support from our experienced professionals. Environment: Collaborate, learn, and exchange ideas across organization. Career Advancement: 18 months comprehensive Tech Graduate Program kicks off in August 2026, ensuring your growth and success at UBS.
